verdict.rationale: Unstructured offers auto-routing to Fast/High Res/VLM partitioning and generative OCR enrichment that could help with scanned/low-quality documents, but there is no direct evidence about accuracy on skewed pages, stamps, or low-quality scans specifically. missing for 10: benchmark or hands-on evidence of OCR accuracy on skewed/rotated pages, stamped documents, low-quality/noisy scans, and any deskewing or image-preprocessing capability documentation.
